evaluation_families.contract: All new ranking and value helpers follow existing generic output-type pattern. Calls rowNumber<number>(), rank<number>(), denseRank<number>(), percentRank<number>(), cumeDist<number>() and ntile<number>(numeric bucket) must type-check.
evaluation_families.missing_joint_test: Type-check any new ranking helper with explicit output type, minimally eb.fn.rowNumber<number>() inside typed person select callback and expect AggregateFunctionBuilder<Database,person,number>. Optional over/orderBy/alias/runtime compile can remain from official fixture, but are unnecessary to reveal zero generic parameters.
evaluation_families.minimal_failure: Just adding <number> to final rowNumber expectType assertion99 suffices statically and is supported by official TS2558 at window-frame.test.ts205. Frame/grouping/nulls/dialect interactions are not required.
evaluation_families.validity_note: All254 failed names share a single build blocker: eight TS2558 sites (six ranking helpers plus repeated rowNumber and ntile). No new-suite runtime assertions executed. This is a product API mismatch causing build abort, not an external environment failure.
